errors: First CI run of changed-ventures failed on the new platform/fuzz/repair.mjs: a literal U+FEFF in the token list (check_hidden_unicode) and a file:// string entry guard (check_cli_entry). Both fixed in a follow-up commit; neither check runs in run_venture_tests, so the local pass missed them.

doc_friction.issue: run_venture_tests.py --changed fails on a fresh shallow clone with no merge base; naming the 50 slugs explicitly worked. The hint it prints is right, but CLAUDE.md suggests --changed as the default.
The list of clean sweeps is long and all static HTML; nothing points runs at behavioural properties of venture logic (idempotence, no-throw), which is where this run found 15 defects.

A local pass of the named venture suites does not run the unwired tree checks (hidden unicode, CLI entry guards) that the changed-ventures CI job runs, so a new platform/ file can pass locally and fail CI.

notes: Idea: mutation-fuzz the 50 file-check ventures' repair() for no-throw and idempotence (platform/fuzz/repair.mjs). 15 defects fixed in 14 ventures (EDI ISA corruption, Xero debit sign, redirect self-loop, BAI2 tie, MT940, vCard, GPX, HubSpot, 5 crashes); repair-fuzz.test.mjs in all 50. Verification: run_venture_tests.py on 50 slugs: 50 suites run, 0 failed; check_posts ok; doc_index ok. Six open cases at other seeds queued in the report. Graduation candidate: apply the same property to other venture families (converters: parse(serialize(x))).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior engineer: write fuzzer, triage and fix 15 defects across 14 parsers, tests, post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
